Mission Statement - To support VOAT and the idea of free expression with the help of other VOATers.

Our Goals

  • To provide monetary support to VOAT via multiple community involved businesses.

  • To help others make money for themselves or a specific cause while also helping VOAT.

  • To have no political agenda except that we consider the right to free expression to be paramount.

Accomplishing These Goals

We will be working on our own accord and with other VOAT users on multiple businesses that will generate income for VOAT. We will seek strategic partnerships with other websites, subverses and businesses.

How You Can Help

Whether you are interested in helping VOAT grow, making money with us, learning ways to generate money on your own, or just being part of something bigger there will be a place for you in ProjectVOAT. Yes, we may need the typical assistance with things like graphics, website development and more but we will also have many ways you can help even if you can only invest a few minutes at a time.

Rewarding Our Partners

We firmly believe in fair play. We are implementing multiple ways that supporters, big and small, will be rewarded for their efforts. We are fully invested into ProjectVOAT and are 100% confident in the success of this endeavor. Those that take a more active role will have the potential for sizable rewards.
